cohort: Pregnant women admitted preferably after 28 weeks of gestation until term pregnancy.
finding: The study found a prevalence of asymptomatic thrombocytopenia in pregnancy of 7.5%, with 65% presenting with mild, 21% with moderate, and 13% with severe thrombocytopenia, concluding that it is usually benign and self-limiting.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, from 28 weeks of gestation until term
gest_age: After 28 weeks of gestation till term pregnancy
